full_details: At nine in the Cross Keys yard Kemp tried a scrap of tune and Garnish would not tick it. The tally stayed twenty-four until the yard had heard the afternoon. Nick wore the watchet and you did not give him a new part. At the lodging the almanac had two lines, Shrove Tuesday and my lord's birthday, and no age under them. You went on as Ferdinand, in the paper crown. The comedy was played a third time. After it Garnish said thirty-five lines in three days, and one whole song. The company drank the patron's health without a number of years, and stacked the inn's trestles. The apprentices were louder than a full stomach accounts for. You did not answer them. You did not copy the new lines into the book.
one_sentence: You kept twenty-four until the yard, heard thirty-five lines and one song, and drank my lord's health.
title: Thirty-five lines, and one song
